runs.name: Consolidated Water Co. Ltd.; Nasdaq CWCO; Cayman Islands water company: retail water on Grand Cayman under an exclusive licence, bulk desalinated water in the Cayman Islands and the Bahamas, water-infrastructure services and manufacturing in the United States, and the OC-BVI affiliate; a new 25-year retail licence from 2026-08-01 (8-K 2026-06-24, Exhibit 10.1); auditor changed 2025 (8-K 2025-04-11); rivals named in the 10-K that file: Seven Seas Water (through AquaVenture) and Jacobs
runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON PRICE (inside the range)
runs.entry: The v5 re-run order, unattended work-hours cycle, one dispatched analyst under the canonical brief, started by the 10:00 cycle and killed after Q4 (last commit 301ea832 at 10:41; the 11:00 cycle skipped it as fresh), resumed by the 11:30 cycle with the resume paragraph. The brief's departures: the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25; the lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the FY2025 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7 (the five segments, the retail licence and its renegotiation, the Bahamas receivables, fixed-price contracts, Hawaii termination for convenience, WSC 22% of revenue, tourism and hurricanes, pegged currencies, the 30% withholding tax, the Mexico project, PERC and REC goodwill, almost no debt), plus the new licence (8-K 2026-06-24) and the auditor change (8-K 2025-04-11). Price **$27.12** (2026-10-28, aggregator via tools/run.py, flagged) x **16,012,865 shares** (10-Q cover, filed 2026-08-10, accession 0001104659-26-093370; no treasury stock; 47,734 redeemable preference shares left out as immaterial) = cap **$434.3M**; sovereign **5.30%** (Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-27). **Q1 IN** (a business of parts; retail decides at about 41% of five-year operating profit, 25-year exclusive licence with an index formula, Condition 44). **Q2 IN on the retail licence** (eight years of renegotiation to "significantly reduce" its income ended in a cut of about $1.9M a year, about 12% of the segment's income; retail about 22% to 26% untaxed on about $43.7M of capital). **Q3 weighs for** (about 18% after tax on $87.9M of operating capital; capital spending below depreciation seven years running). **Q4 IN, weighs for** (ten balance sheets FY2016 to FY2025; no debt to speak of; cash $39M to $124M, $132.6M at 2026-06-30, half of total assets; Bahamas receivable $20.7M, 71% overdue, no allowance; adverse internal-control opinion for 2024, reported remediated for 2025). **Q5 integrity IN, ability weighs for modestly** (CEO 22 years, 285,102 shares; the Mexico project 14 years for its cost back). **Q6 Part A undecided, Part B against lightly** ($380.6M of market value for $51.8M retained, but more than all of it in cash; revenue-heavy targets, the 2023 to 2025 EPS target below the run rate, consultant peer benchmarking; no buybacks; the 2023 PERC deal not wholly in shares, STOP not engaged). **Q7 OUT, the price inside the range**: owner cash after stock pay, all capital spending, minority dividends and business purchases, before interest income, FY2019 to FY2025 average **$14.75M a year** (both ends of the literal five-year window distorted by the filer's own account, specific (a)); growth 14.8% a year between the halves, from a COVID-trough base and one contract; the regulated-utility section judged not to apply (a price-cap licence, no long-term debt), all-equity central. Value range **$25.32 to $62.85 a share** (2.48 to 1); 4.80% no-growth and 12.04% growth at the price; **fair price $24.85 all-equity, central; $18.21 equity-only beside**; with growth capped at the discount rate $25.32 to $33.51, fair $18.77; the literal window $25.76 to $34.46, fair $19.17; inside the range in every case. Facts after the stop recorded, not weighed. Strongest evidence against, as the analyst put it: the deciding part has no pricing power of its own (rates frozen from 2018, the new licence cuts them, the formula indexes 55% of the base rate); the Cabinet can change the licence with or without the company's agreement; one delinquent government debtor at 22% of revenue; growth not shown by the licensed retail business. Could not get: a maintenance and growth split of spending (all-spending case central, depreciation beside); which director shares were bought with own money; a rival that files over the same years; the 30% withholding tax on US profits not priced in (about $0.99 a share off every figure if charged). Framework gaps for the operator: two readings of the growth cap (Q7's first convention, no rate past the discount rate, against specific (f), the shown rate for ten years; the analyst made (f) central, which moves fair from $18.77 to $24.85; OUT either way). Analyst's commits: pathspec commits after each question or pair, Q5 with Q6 in f18938ac, Q7 and the box in 2e2c3c1b. Process slip recorded: the analyst corrected a committed Q3 citation (M1998-081 to M1994-081) in place with a dated note during the resumed run, rather than by addendum; the run was still open, said in its self-audit. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; no E-ids, every id in the ledger, 36 adjacent fragment pairs checked by `dispatcher_cite_check.py`, one flagged (L2005-015 beside "at comparable companies", a proxy quote attributed in the same sentence, a checker mispairing, not a slip); no tracked research file over 200 KB. Contamination declared: commit subjects of another run (WTRG) and the git status at session start, and a memory index line; none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Armed at the all-equity fair price.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7 on price: a Cayman Islands water company whose deciding part is a 25-year exclusive retail water licence on Grand Cayman with an index formula and a government able to change it, no debt and half its assets in cash; owner cash $14.75M a year FY2019 to FY2025; value range $25.32 to $62.85 against $27.12, inside the range. Fair $24.85 all-equity, central; $18.21 equity-only beside; armed.
runs.fair_label: CWCO v5 fair price, ALL-EQUITY (central; the regulated-utility section judged not to apply, a price-cap licence and no long-term debt): $24.85; equity-only $18.21 beside; $18.77 with growth capped at the discount rate. Run 2026-10-28 (Test Runs/2026-10-28 Run - CWCO Consolidated Water.md; OUT at Q7 at $27.12, inside the value range $25.32 to $62.85). Reporting figure; any price below fair is read as cheap by the operator; a hit means re-run, not a buy.
